direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels like a mess because Tommy intentionally tried to make a bad movie and it shows; The direction on a microscale is very over the top and bad, something you would expect from Tommy; Storytelling is all over the place and bad, not having any of the charm from 'The Room' because he's intentionally trying to tell a bad story; He sets up tension in a very bad and campy way; This movie just feels like a shitty student film

performance.comments: Johnny from 'The Room,' but Xaned out

cast.comments: What you would expect from a movie intentionally trying to be a bad movie;

story.comments: The concept is just dumb and incoherent; The plot structure is all over the place; Character writing is nonexistent

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is just awful and bad, having none of the charm from The Room because he's intentionally trying to make it bad; the humor is still somewhat there, half being from Tommy being Tommy and half from wondering how this movie even got made; the foreshadowing is nonexistent as he's making up the movie as he is going

soundtrack.comments: Tommy paid for the full song, and he is making sure he is getting his money's worth

cinematography.comments: This movie is shot like a shitty YouTube student film

editing.comments: This movie is shot like a shitty YouTube student film

sound.comments: This movie sounds like a shitty YouTube student film

visual_effects.comments: I'm pretty sure Tommy did the VFX himself

review.pacing: Pacing is very slow as Tommy is just trying to fill time; This movie feels like it was shot in a week
review.climax: Climax is just a campy, bad movie, somewhat enjoyable, though;
review.tone: "Tone is just a bad movie"; "The charm about 'The Room' is that Tommy tried to make a good movie but it was so bad, this movie doesn't have any of that charm because he intentionally tried to just make a bad movie"
review.overall: Overall, the charm about "The Room" is that Tommy Wiseau tried to make a good movie but it was so bad, this movie has none of that because Tommy intentionally tried to make a bad movie and it shows; there are some moments that are enjoyable and have the camp that Tommy Wiseau is known for, but this movie at the end of the day just plays like a shitty YouTube student film
